headline: Binance says it has fully lifted the withdrawal freeze from its $6.3 billion October hack, as about $7 billion of bitcoin options were due to expire at 08:00 UTC and US bitcoin funds stay on course for their worst month on record.

market.asOf: Read from CoinMarketCap's homepage at about 08:00 UTC Fri 27 Nov (15:00 Bangkok). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Alternative.me's index reads 11 out of 100 ("Extreme Fear", 13 a day earlier); CoinMarketCap's Fear and Greed Index reads 10 ("Extreme fear"). Read about 07:57-08:00 UTC Fri 27 Nov.

stories.title: Binance fully lifts its withdrawal freeze four weeks after the $6.3 billion hack
stories.summary: Binance, the world's biggest crypto exchange, says withdrawals are back to normal after the 29 October hack. Withdrawals had been reopening in stages, and a few networks remain paused for maintenance.
points: Binance said "the withdrawal suspension from the October security incident has been fully lifted", per CoinDesk.
The hack affected about $6.3 billion in assets, of which about $3 billion was frozen, per CoinDesk.
Binance said it had restored 90% of the stolen crypto by 31 Oct, using company funds and its SAFU emergency reserve, and 98% of the $6.34 billion by 3 Nov, per CoinDesk.
Withdrawals for a small number of networks are still temporarily paused for maintenance or planned upgrades, per Binance via CoinDesk.
TRM Labs linked the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, and the FBI also pointed to North Korea, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk: Binance says its withdrawal suspension is over

stories.title: About $7 billion of bitcoin options were due to expire at 08:00 UTC today, with most big bets on further falls
stories.summary: Deribit's bitcoin options were due to expire at 08:00 UTC (3pm Bangkok), alongside $0.6 billion of ether options, and bitcoin rose into the expiry. Big expiries can move prices around settlement; the settlement price was not yet reported when this page was written.
points: About $7 billion of bitcoin options and $0.6 billion of ether options were due to expire on Deribit, per CoinDesk; crypto.news, citing CryptoQuant, gives $6.8 billion of bitcoin options and a "max pain" level of $70,000.
CoinDesk put the put/call ratio for this expiry at 0.89, against 0.55 before October's, with heavy put clusters across $63,000 to $75,000.
Bitcoin was at $61,855, up 2.26% over 24 hours, at 06:17 UTC, per TokenPost; CoinMarketCap showed $60,737 at about 08:00 UTC.

sources.label: CoinDesk: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday
crypto.news: bitcoin rebounds before $6.8B options expiry

stories.title: US bitcoin funds head for a record-bad month, and Strategy leaves MSCI's indexes on Monday
stories.summary: November withdrawals from US spot bitcoin funds have already set a record. Index funds tracking MSCI must sell Strategy (MSTR) shares by Monday's close, while JPMorgan reads Strategy's record-low value against its bitcoin as capitulation (sellers giving up).
points: US spot bitcoin funds lost a net $453.1 million on Wed 25 Nov, the seventh straight day of outflows; BlackRock's IBIT accounted for $329.7 million, per The Block.

November outflows total about $5.39 billion, already past the previous monthly record, per The Block. US spot ether funds lost $68.5 million on Wednesday, their ninth straight outflow day, and $1.3 billion in November.
Strategy's mNAV (market value divided by the value of its bitcoin) fell to about 0.88x on 25 Nov, then recovered to 0.94x; JPMorgan called it a record low, per The Block.
MSCI's removal of Strategy takes effect after the close on Mon 30 Nov; MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million shares (3.1%), and JPMorgan estimated about $2.8 billion of selling, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Asian finance officials form a digital payments working group
briefs.summary: Finance and central bank deputies from China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN agreed to form a cross-border digital payments program and a working group that also covers digital-asset rules; ministers are due to discuss it in Nagoya in May 2027, per The Block.

briefs.title: CFTC staff let venues count bitcoin and ether toward reserves
briefs.summary: CFTC staff said they would not object to derivatives venues counting BTC and ETH with at least a 20% haircut, and payment stablecoins with a 2% haircut, per Blockhead.

briefs.title: BitMart reported $319.5 million short
briefs.summary: Citing Nikkei Asia, Cointelegraph reports BitMart has a $319.5 million shortfall and $1.9 million of liquid assets for customer repayments, with Alvarez & Marsal overseeing the restructuring.

calendar.event: US stock markets close early after Thanksgiving
calendar.note: Stocks close at 1:00pm ET, per NYSE; SIFMA recommends a 2:00pm ET early close for US bond markets.

calendar.event: Binance Blockchain Week, Bangkok; Fed quiet period begins
calendar.note: At the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, per VentureSquare. The Fed's pre-meeting blackout runs from Sat 28 Nov to Thu 10 Dec, per the Fed's blackout calendar.

calendar.event: Token unlocks: PROS, GRASS, FF, CARDS, GRVT, KMNO, GUN, EIGEN, SUI, M, BTW, ENA, 2Z, Q, STO, MMT, LA
calendar.note: PROS and GRASS on Saturday 28; FF and CARDS on Sunday 29; GRVT, KMNO and GUN on Monday 30 (one tracker gives GUN on the 29th); EIGEN and SUI on Tuesday 1 Dec; M, BTW, ENA, 2Z and Q on Wednesday 2 Dec (M's date is disputed: Tokenomist shows 12 Dec); STO on Thursday 3 Dec; MMT and LA on Friday 4 Dec. See the unlock table on this page for sizes and confidence. (Dates from this desk's unlock data.)
October was 55.3 (September 58.8), per Newsquawk. Release time per MNI.

calendar.event: Trump Media (DJT) noteholders can demand repayment
calendar.note: Holders of its convertible notes can require the company to buy them back for cash; about $883.5 million is outstanding after a $100 million buyback, per Bitcoin.com News.

calendar.event: MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) from its indexes
calendar.note: Takes effect after the close on 30 Nov. MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million MSTR shares, about 3.1% of the total; JPMorgan estimated about $2.8 billion of selling, per Cointelegraph.

calendar.event: ISM manufacturing PMI (Nov), job openings (JOLTS, Oct); Fed's Bowman testifies to the House
calendar.note: ISM: October was 55.5, per ISM; Wells Fargo expects 53.8, per ActionForex. JOLTS: September was about 7.5 million, per the BLS, which schedules October's release for 10:00am. Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman testifies at the House Financial Services "Oversight of Prudential Regulators" hearing, per the Fed's calendar. Marvell reports after the close, per Earnings Whispers.
Both report after the close, per Earnings Whispers. ADP's private payrolls count for October was +86,000, per Fox Business; the November report's date is not confirmed here.

Forecasts differ: Continuum Economics expects +95,000 and Wells Fargo +80,000, both with unemployment at 4.1%. October payrolls rose 165,000, per Continuum Economics. Release at 8:30am ET, per FinanceCalendar.

Markets expect a rate hike, not a cut: CME FedWatch put the chance of a hike at 99.4% on 26 Nov, per Invezz on TradingView; MarketSpeaker reported a 97.8% chance of a quarter-point hike on 25 Nov. Press conference at 2:30pm ET, per the Fed's calendar.
